About us

Jim Carter, owner of Acme Roofing, founded the company in 1998 after twenty years on other people's crews.

His daughter Dana Carter runs the office and schedules every estimate.

We install, repair and replace asphalt shingle, tile and metal roofs for homeowners. Every job starts with a free inspection, a written estimate and photos of what we found. Our crews clean up every nail at the end of the day, and we stand behind our work with a ten-year workmanship warranty. We work with every major insurance company after hail and monsoon storms, and we can meet your adjuster on the roof. Gutters, skylights, flashing and attic ventilation are part of every inspection, because a roof only lasts as long as the details around it.
